scope: Illustration production only. No Unreal import or character/UI connection.

portraits.name: Yura
portraits.identity: YURA has pale skin, bright fuchsia pink eyes with graphic heart-like dark pupils, faint cheek freckles, deep dark-purple long twin tails with large round side buns, full fringe and a small curved forelock, two small tapered purple horns in front of the buns. The long twin tails fall below the waist and terminate in short thick braids and loose ends. White small hair ribbons. Violet short pleated dress with white shoulder ruffles and white small collar, black neck bow edged hot pink, vivid pink crossed harness straps on the bodice, wide black buckled waist corset with pink side lacing, detached violet puff sleeves with black straps and cuff frills, dark translucent tights and a black thigh strap. NO bat wings, no short bob, no extra accessories. Gentle subtly mischievous smile, shoulders slightly angled, one bare hand loosely touching the opposite sleeve cuff near waist, the other lowered.
portraits.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE finished hand-drawn 2D character illustration for the Moonlit Sanctuary Unreal RPG character selection portrait set, vertical 1024x1536 PNG, genuine transparent background. Images 1 and 2 are reference images of the SAME character's actual game model: costume full view and face. These define identity, colors, anatomy, garments and accessories. Image 3 is an existing portrait from this project's approved set, STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: use the same thin varied warm ink contours, refined expressive anime face, matte colors, clean restrained cel shading with delicate painterly softening, carefully drawn fabric and hair. Never copy image 3's person, hair ornaments or costume. Faithfully illustrate the model, without redesign. Composition: centered head to mid-thigh, normal undistorted proportions, face in upper quarter, complete hair and horns with 5% clear top margin, both hands and shoulders within frame; comfortable lowered arms instead of reference T-pose. Pure alpha outside the figure; NO background, atmospheric glow, halo, shadow cloud, scenery, floor, text, watermark, UI or frame. Same garment coverage as the model, nonsexual natural pose. The long twin tails fall below the waist and terminate in short thick braids and loose ends. White small hair ribbons. Violet short pleated dress with white shoulder ruffles and white small collar, black neck bow edged hot pink, vivid pink crossed harness straps on the bodice, wide black buckled waist corset with pink side lacing, detached violet puff sleeves with black straps and cuff frills, dark translucent tights and a black thigh strap. NO bat wings, no short bob, no extra accessories. Gentle subtly mischievous smile, shoulders slightly angled, one bare hand loosely touching the opposite sleeve cuff near waist, the other lowered.

portraits.name: Hwarin
portraits.identity: HWARIN has pale warm skin, vivid red eyes, short layered BLACK hair with dark red undersides and a tied-back crown tuft, TWO long upward tapered horns with warm brown bases and near-black tips. Black Japanese haori jacket with RED lining and red sleeve diagonal markings, red and white twisted ropes on shoulders, round antique metal tomoe clasps with red tassels. Red-orange short patterned kimono panels with white flowers over black floral chest panel, broad red-orange obi bow and black belts, black fingerless gloves, black and gold choker and silver chain magatama pendant. Preserve original coverage and model proportions. NO blue haori, no white hair, no tan orange oni skin. Confident warm small smile, one hand resting naturally at obi hip, other lowered.

portraits.name: Arin
portraits.identity: ARIN has pale skin, muted rose-red eyes, layered charcoal/ash-grey shoulder-length hair with outward feathered ends and straight fringe. Asymmetric front locks: viewer-right a single braid secured low with a dark gold band, viewer-left a loose long lock bound high with a dark gold band. Black choker with small central black loop. Black cropped sailor blouse with WHITE sailor collar and thin dark stripes, long MINT TURQUOISE necktie, narrow visible midriff, black pleated short skirt and black belt. Long BLACK open coat with broad sleeves, white rectangular upper-arm stripe details and irregular distressed pointed coat hem, black thigh-high stockings and a black thigh strap. No hat, no horns, no glasses, no white naval dress or cape. Quiet gentle expression, upright relaxed stance, one bare hand lightly gathering coat edge near waist, the other lowered. Keep mint tie fully legible.
